report:
Brain, right frontal lesion, stereotactic biopsy

Two smear preparations are made from the tissue. They show brain parenchyma only. Sections show brain parenchyma with reactive astrocytosis; no lesional tissue is identified in the material examined.

BRAIN, right frontal lobe, stereotactic biopsy - NO LESIONAL TISSUE IDENTIFIED; brain parenchyma with reactive gliosis only

The tissue available is limited and a higher-grade component elsewhere in the lesion cannot be excluded; correlation with imaging is recommended.
